title: Brave New MTS
summary: Requires Multi-Team Support. Brave New World-style multiplayer for MTS: no character, bots only. Your character never leaves its cell, so teams play remote-only through remote view and construction robots build everything from the blueprints you place. No handcrafting, no hand-mining, no god mode. A starter base on every team surface. Inspired by Brave New OARC.
category_note: scenarios on purpose: Brave New World family peers (brave-new-world, brave-new-oarc, brave-new-world-for-2-0) all live there. See 5060c7e; the overhaul case is in 05f0465.
